item.title: Why Nobody Can Read the Voynich Manuscript
item.description: An AI-generated NotebookLM conversation about the Voynich manuscript: its illustrated pages, scientific examination, language-like patterns, and disputed interpretations. The manuscript remains undeciphered; this episode explores evidence and hypotheses rather than claiming a solution.
